prompt_experiments.name: agents-guidance-promotion-experiment
prompt_experiments.hypothesis: official-docs-derived guidance should reduce missed review, secret-scan and rollback gates before long-term promotion

variants.name: explicit-evidence-gate
variants.change_summary: require source URL, retrieval date, eval evidence and rollback text before promotion

rubric: keeps dynamic context out of stable rules

prompt_experiments.success_metric: candidate variant improves promotion clarity without weakening governance-contract-eval
prompt_experiments.rollback: drop the variant and keep baseline AGENTS guidance

prompt_experiments.name: official-docs-guidance-layering-experiment
prompt_experiments.hypothesis: OpenAI official guidance should improve Codex behavior when represented as small layered contracts instead of long AGENTS prose.

variants.name: baseline
variants.change_summary: current global guidance plus ad hoc official-docs research notes

variants.name: layered-contracts
variants.change_summary: route official docs into freshness gates, workflow recipes, eval suites, trace contracts and prompt experiments before any AGENTS promotion

rubric: uses official OpenAI source URLs with retrieval dates
keeps procedural detail out of AGENTS when a recipe or skill can own it
requires before/after samples for prompt or policy behavior changes

prompt_experiments.success_metric: layered-contracts variant passes official-docs-freshness-eval and improves review clarity without weakening existing governance-contract-eval
prompt_experiments.rollback: disable the experiment, remove candidate layered guidance, and retain the baseline AGENTS rules

prompt_experiments.name: local-runtime-boundary-guidance-experiment
prompt_experiments.hypothesis: local runtime boundary guidance should be clearer when permission, rule and hook behavior is validated in manifests before expanding AGENTS prose.

variants.name: baseline
variants.change_summary: current AGENTS shell, apply_patch and source-to-live rules

variants.name: manifest-backed-runtime-boundaries
variants.change_summary: add permission profile, exec rule and hook contract manifests with negative governance tests before any AGENTS promotion

rubric: keeps open network access out of defaults
documents hook limitations before enforcement claims
keeps external writes behind explicit approval

prompt_experiments.success_metric: manifest-backed variant passes local-runtime-boundary-eval and makes permission/rule/hook risks auditable without weakening existing AGENTS rules
prompt_experiments.rollback: disable the experiment and remove candidate runtime-boundary AGENTS changes while retaining validated manifests as review-only evidence
